newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICAN SUPERSPORT SERIES RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICAN SUPERSPORT SERIES RESULTS.

text.p: Results of four-day Supersport Series cricket matches on Monday:
Durban: Natal v Free State - match drawn. Natal 282 and 349-7 declared, Free State 160 and 312-9 (Deon Jordaan 81, Boeta Dippenaar 93, Philip Radley 58 not out).

Port Elizabeth: Eastern Province beat Western Province by five wickets. Western Province 401-2 declared and 228-6 declared (Jacques Kallis 79, H.D.Ackerman 102 not out), Eastern Province 300-9 declared and 331-5 (Kepler Wessels 179, Dave Callaghan 88).
